#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Arc for Firefox: give Arc the whole window (macOS & Linux).
#
# Adds Arc's layout to the Firefox profile that has Arc installed:
#   <profile>/chrome/userChrome.css  hides Firefox's tab strip and toolbar
#   <profile>/user.js                turns the stylesheet on, horizontal tabs,
#                                    opens Arc at startup
# Your own CSS and prefs are kept: Arc only manages its marked block.
#
# Usage:  bash arc-setup.sh              set up (or update)
#         bash arc-setup.sh --uninstall  remove Arc's blocks again
# Generated by scripts/build-setup.mjs; edit extras/ instead.
set -euo pipefail

ADDON_ID="arc@sidebar"
CSS_BEGIN="/* >>> Arc for Firefox >>> */"
CSS_END="/* <<< Arc for Firefox <<< */"
JS_BEGIN="// >>> Arc for Firefox >>>"
JS_END="// <<< Arc for Firefox <<<"

UNINSTALL=0
[ "${1:-}" = "--uninstall" ] && UNINSTALL=1

case "$(uname -s)" in
  Darwin) ROOTS=("$HOME/Library/Application Support/Firefox/Profiles") ;;
  *) ROOTS=("$HOME/.mozilla/firefox" "$HOME/snap/firefox/common/.mozilla/firefox" "$HOME/.var/app/org.mozilla.firefox/.mozilla/firefox") ;;
esac

# Every Firefox profile folder (has prefs.js); Arc's first.
ARC=()
OTHER=()
for root in "${ROOTS[@]}"; do
  [ -d "$root" ] || continue
  for dir in "$root"/*/; do
    dir="${dir%/}"
    [ -f "$dir/prefs.js" ] || continue
    if grep -q "\"id\":\"$ADDON_ID\"" "$dir/extensions.json" 2>/dev/null; then ARC+=("$dir"); else OTHER+=("$dir"); fi
  done
done

if [ ${#ARC[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
  CANDIDATES=("${ARC[@]}")
else
  echo "No Firefox profile with Arc installed was found. Install Arc first, or pick a profile:"
  CANDIDATES=("${OTHER[@]}")
fi
[ ${#CANDIDATES[@]} -gt 0 ] || { echo "No Firefox profiles found." >&2; exit 1; }

PROFILE="${CANDIDATES[0]}"
if [ ${#CANDIDATES[@]} -gt 1 ]; then
  echo "Several Firefox profiles found:"
  i=1
  for p in "${CANDIDATES[@]}"; do echo "  $i) $(basename "$p")"; i=$((i + 1)); done
  printf "Which one? [1-%s] " "${#CANDIDATES[@]}"
  read -r pick < /dev/tty
  case "$pick" in ''|*[!0-9]*) echo "Not a number." >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
  [ "$pick" -ge 1 ] && [ "$pick" -le ${#CANDIDATES[@]} ] || { echo "Out of range." >&2; exit 1; }
  PROFILE="${CANDIDATES[$((pick - 1))]}"
fi

# Replace (or remove) the marked block in a file, keeping everything else.
write_block() {
  local file="$1" begin="$2" end="$3" content="$4" tmp
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$file")"
  touch "$file"
  tmp="$(mktemp)"
  # Drop the old block (and trailing blank lines), keep everything else.
  awk -v b="$begin" -v e="$end" '
    index($0, b) { skip = 1 }
    !skip { if ($0 == "") blank++; else { while (blank > 0) { print ""; blank-- } print } }
    index($0, e) { skip = 0 }' "$file" > "$tmp"
  if [ "$UNINSTALL" -eq 0 ]; then
    [ -s "$tmp" ] && printf '\n' >> "$tmp"
    printf '%s\n%s\n%s\n' "$begin" "$content" "$end" >> "$tmp"
  fi
  cat "$tmp" > "$file"
  rm -f "$tmp"
}

# read -d '' (not $(cat <<...)): macOS bash 3.2 misparses quotes inside $( heredoc ).
IFS= read -r -d '' CSS <<'ARC_EOF' || true
/*
 * ArcFox layout for Firefox. Always on: ArcFox's sidebar replaces the tab strip
 * and toolbar. Firefox's pinned extension buttons (+ extensions and main menu
 * buttons) become a row of tiles in the sidebar, above the ArcFox address bar.
 *
 * Setup (pair with extras/user.js, which also opens ArcFox at startup):
 *   1. about:support -> Profile Folder -> Open. Create a "chrome" folder there.
 *   2. Copy this file into it as chrome/userChrome.css.
 *   3. Copy extras/user.js into the profile folder, then restart Firefox.
 * Which extensions show: pin/unpin them via the puzzle-piece menu.
 * Tip: remap ArcFox's "Focus the address bar" to Cmd/Ctrl+L in
 *      about:addons -> gear -> Manage Extension Shortcuts.
 */

:root {
  --arcfox-sidebar-width: 260px;
  /* Draggable title-bar patch at the sidebar's top-left (window buttons). */
  --arcfox-titlebar-width: 150px;
  /* Must match ArcFox's layout: row starts 40px into the sidebar, 30px tall. */
  --arcfox-ext-top: 40px;
  --arcfox-ext-height: 30px;
  --arcfox-ext-tile: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
  --arcfox-ext-hover: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
  --arcfox-ext-active: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
}

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  :root {
    --arcfox-ext-tile: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
    --arcfox-ext-hover: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.11);
    --arcfox-ext-active: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
  }
}

/* ---------- Firefox chrome ArcFox replaces ---------- */

/* Firefox's sidebar launcher and the panel header ("Arc  x"):
   #sidebar-header in the old sidebar; #sidebar-panel-header in the new one,
   which lives inside the panel document (webext-panels.xhtml). */
#sidebar-panel-header,
#sidebar-container,
#sidebar-launcher-splitter,
#sidebar-header,
#sidebar-splitter {
  visibility: collapse !important;
  display: none !important;
}

/* What's left of the tab strip: a transparent patch in the sidebar's empty
   top-left corner (Arc's nav buttons sit on the right). It keeps the macOS
   window buttons, window dragging and double-click to zoom. The tabs stay
   hidden; Arc lists them. */
#TabsToolbar {
  position: fixed !important;
  z-index: 4 !important;
  top: 0 !important;
  left: 0 !important;
  width: var(--arcfox-titlebar-width) !important;
  height: var(--arcfox-ext-top) !important;
  min-height: 0 !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  border: 0 !important;
  background: transparent !important;
}
#TabsToolbar > .toolbar-items,
#TabsToolbar .private-browsing-indicator-with-label {
  visibility: collapse !important;
}

/* Sharp edge between Arc and the page: Firefox rounds and shadows both the
   sidebar panel and the content area. */
#sidebar,
#sidebar-box,
.sidebar-browser-stack,
#tabbrowser-tabbox,
#tabbrowser-tabpanels,
.browserSidebarContainer,
.browserContainer,
.browserStack,
#tabbrowser-tabpanels browser {
  border-radius: 0 !important;
  border: none !important;
  outline: none !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
}

/* Firefox leaves a gap under the sidebar (padding-block-end); Arc fills it. */
#sidebar-box,
#sidebar-container,
.sidebar-browser-stack {
  padding: 0 !important;
}

/* The separator line itself (Firefox draws it as a border on the sidebar). */
:root {
  --sidebar-border-color: transparent !important;
  --chrome-content-separator-color: transparent !important;
}

/* Fixed width so the extensions row lines up with the sidebar. */
#sidebar-box {
  width: var(--arcfox-sidebar-width) !important;
  min-width: var(--arcfox-sidebar-width) !important;
  max-width: var(--arcfox-sidebar-width) !important;
}

/* Arc's own small windows (command bar, space editor) are popups: no toolbar. */
#main-window[chromehidden~="toolbar"] #nav-bar {
  display: none !important;
}

/* ---------- Toolbar -> extensions row inside the sidebar ---------- */

/* Sidebar hidden with Option+Shift+S (Arc sets an invisible window-title marker),
   or closed: the page goes full width and the extensions row hides too. */
#main-window[titlepreface="\200B"] :is(#sidebar-box, #nav-bar),
#main-window:has(#sidebar-box[hidden]) #nav-bar {
  display: none !important;
}

/* The toolbox forms its own stacking context; lift it above the sidebar. */
#navigator-toolbox {
  position: relative !important;
  z-index: 10 !important;
}

#nav-bar {
  position: fixed !important;
  z-index: 3 !important;
  top: var(--arcfox-ext-top) !important;
  left: 8px !important;
  width: calc(var(--arcfox-sidebar-width) - 16px) !important;
  height: var(--arcfox-ext-height) !important;
  min-height: 0 !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  border: 0 !important;
  background: transparent !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
  --toolbarbutton-outer-padding: 0px;
  --toolbarbutton-inner-padding: 7px;
  --toolbarbutton-border-radius: 8px;
  --toolbarbutton-hover-background: var(--arcfox-ext-hover);
  --toolbarbutton-active-background: var(--arcfox-ext-active);
  --toolbar-start-end-padding: 0px;
}

/* Flatten the button group so every button is an equal tile in one row. */
#nav-bar-customization-target {
  display: contents !important;
}

/* Keep only extension buttons (never Arc's own), extensions menu, main menu,
   and the (off-screen) address bar below. */
#nav-bar-customization-target > :not(.unified-extensions-item, .webextension-browser-action, #unified-extensions-button, #urlbar-container),
#nav-bar .webextension-browser-action[id^="arc_sidebar"],
#nav-bar-overflow-button,
#nav-bar > :not(#nav-bar-customization-target, #unified-extensions-button, #PanelUI-button) {
  display: none !important;
}

#nav-bar :is(.unified-extensions-item, .webextension-browser-action),
#unified-extensions-button,
#PanelUI-button {
  flex: 1 1 0 !important;
  min-width: 0 !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  margin-inline-start: 4px !important;
  height: var(--arcfox-ext-height) !important;
}
#nav-bar :is(.unified-extensions-item, .webextension-browser-action, #unified-extensions-button, #PanelUI-button):not([hidden]):first-of-type {
  margin-inline-start: 0 !important;
}
#PanelUI-button {
  padding: 0 !important;
  border: 0 !important;
}

/* The tile: stretch each button's visual box across its slot. */
#nav-bar :is(.unified-extensions-item, .webextension-browser-action) .toolbarbutton-1,
#unified-extensions-button,
#PanelUI-menu-button {
  width: 100% !important;
  height: var(--arcfox-ext-height) !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
}
#nav-bar :is(.unified-extensions-item, .webextension-browser-action) .toolbarbutton-1 > :is(.toolbarbutton-badge-stack, .toolbarbutton-icon),
#unified-extensions-button > .toolbarbutton-icon,
#PanelUI-menu-button > :is(.toolbarbutton-badge-stack, .toolbarbutton-icon) {
  width: 100% !important;
  height: var(--arcfox-ext-height) !important;
  padding-block: calc((var(--arcfox-ext-height) - 16px) / 2) !important;
  padding-inline: calc(50% - 8px) !important;
  border-radius: 8px !important;
  background-color: var(--arcfox-ext-tile);
  justify-content: center !important;
}
#nav-bar .toolbarbutton-1:not([disabled]):hover > :is(.toolbarbutton-badge-stack, .toolbarbutton-icon) {
  background-color: var(--arcfox-ext-hover) !important;
}
#nav-bar .toolbarbutton-1:not([disabled]):is([open], [checked], :hover:active) > :is(.toolbarbutton-badge-stack, .toolbarbutton-icon) {
  background-color: var(--arcfox-ext-active) !important;
}

/* ---------- Firefox's address bar: hidden until Cmd/Ctrl+L ----------
   Arc has its own address bar, but Firefox pages (about:config, ...) can only
   be opened from Firefox's. It waits off-screen and shows as a centered bar
   while focused. */
#urlbar-container {
  position: fixed !important;
  z-index: 30 !important;
  top: -400px !important;
  left: 50% !important;
  width: min(680px, 70vw) !important;
  max-width: none !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
}
#urlbar-container:focus-within {
  top: 16vh !important;
}
#urlbar-container:focus-within #urlbar-background {
  box-shadow: 0 16px 48px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25), 0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08) !important;
}
ARC_EOF
CSS="${CSS%$'\n'}"

IFS= read -r -d '' PREFS <<'ARC_EOF' || true
// ArcFox: copy into your Firefox profile folder (next to prefs.js).
// Firefox applies these on every start.

// Load chrome/userChrome.css.
user_pref("toolkit.legacyUserProfileCustomizations.stylesheets", true);
// Horizontal tabs (their strip is hidden; ArcFox lists the tabs).
user_pref("sidebar.verticalTabs", false);
// Closing the last tab keeps the window (with a new tab), like Arc.
user_pref("browser.tabs.closeWindowWithLastTab", false);
// Reopen windows and tabs, including the open ArcFox sidebar.
user_pref("browser.startup.page", 3);
// Fallback when there is no session to restore: ArcFox panel open, launcher hidden.
user_pref("sidebar.backupState", "{\"command\":\"arc_sidebar-sidebar-action\",\"panelOpen\":true,\"panelWidth\":260,\"launcherVisible\":false,\"launcherExpanded\":false}");
ARC_EOF
PREFS="${PREFS%$'\n'}"

write_block "$PROFILE/chrome/userChrome.css" "$CSS_BEGIN" "$CSS_END" "$CSS"
write_block "$PROFILE/user.js" "$JS_BEGIN" "$JS_END" "$PREFS"

if [ "$UNINSTALL" -eq 1 ]; then
  echo "Removed Arc's layout from $(basename "$PROFILE")."
  echo "Restart Firefox. user.js prefs already applied stay until you change them in about:config."
else
  echo "Arc's layout is set up in $(basename "$PROFILE")."
  echo "Quit Firefox completely and open it again."
fi
